name: Salzer Electronics Ltd
title: Salzer Electronics Ltd-$ - 517059 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Margins squeezed by plastic and copper inflation (2-3% hit); FY27 EBITDA guided 9-9.5% after a June 7-10% price hike, while working capital ran near 30% of revenue vs a 25% target.

capex.quote: we will be investing close to around INR 15 crores in Phase-1 to set up and start the operations

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin 9-9.5%
triggers.quote: For FY27, guidance is what we are trying to achieve 9-9.5%.

triggers.label: June price hike 7-10%
triggers.quote: In June, we will be doing a price increase of close to between 7% and 10% for different products.

triggers.label: Working capital ~30% of revenue vs 25% target
triggers.quote: we have exceeded that and we have touched around 30%

triggers.label: Smart meter: no large long-term orders
triggers.quote: As of now, we have not secured any large long-term orders

triggers.label: Feb 2026 price hike ~15% accepted
triggers.quote: we have done a very good pass on of close to 15% price increase in February 2026

guidance.quote: For FY27, guidance is what we are trying to achieve 9-9.5%.
we expect we will reach a top line of around INR 2,000 crores to INR 2,100 crores
we also want to go back to that 25% sort of revenue mix for FY27
we expect that the EBITDA margin from these products will be between 12% and 15%
this Saudi plant has to generate INR 100 crores of revenue catering to the GCC countries
The entire year, I think we expect close to around INR 25 crores of revenue.
Overall, I think next quarter, Q2 onwards, it might stabilize between 12% and 13%.
I think our target is around 18% ROCE.

prior_guidance_check.quote: a couple of quarters before we had guided that we will definitely reach 9.5-10% EBITDA margin

red_flags.label: Short-term borrowings INR 503 crore; wires margin ~1-2.5% PAT after interest
red_flags.quote: So, out of INR 500 crores borrowings, I think around INR 200 to INR 250 crores we are using for the wires and cables business

red_flags.label: Working capital ~30% of revenue vs 25% policy
red_flags.quote: we have exceeded that and we have touched around 30%

red_flags.label: Smart meter inventory held with no firm orders
Receivable days 90-95 days
red_flags.quote: I think we continue to maintain between 90 and 95 days of receivables.

evasions.topic: Smart meter order timing and quantum
evasions.quote: I don't think there's any update on that front as of now
It will be difficult to provide that information here in the call
